leadText:
Blossom's parents are a duo of characters that appeared in Blossom's Dream, the third episode of the POKÉTOON animated shorts.

In the past, the two were Pokémon Trainers who participated in the Galar League. Sometime after birth, loved watching her father's battle videos. This inspired Blossom to become a Pokémon Trainer too, and some time later, she decided it was time to go out on a journey. While her father approved of this, her mother believed it was still not the right time.

During an incident involving a family of and , Blossom's parents finally realized that their daughter had achieved the necessary maturity to become a Pokémon Trainer. A few days passed and Blossom set out on her own journey, and her parents remembered the moment that defined their lives; the battle where the mother defeated her future husband in a Pokémon battle in competition.
